sections.title: Remember These Three Things First
sections.callout: Stand between pillars, never directly next to one, during the lightning chain phase.
calloutDetail: The Arbiter channels lightning between four arena pillars. Any player within 3 metres of an active pillar takes chain damage that escalates with each bounce.
The safe zone is the exact centre between any two adjacent pillars — roughly 5 metres from each.

sections.title: How to Reach the Arbiter of Divinity

steps.label: Enter the Trial of the Sekhemas
body: The Trial is accessed from the Kingsmarch hub via the Trial portal. It is available once you reach Level 60 and complete the preceding trial floors.

steps.label: Clear three preceding chambers
body: The Chamber of Judgement is the fourth and final chamber. You must clear Chambers of Weight, Passage and Storm first.

steps.label: Enter the Chamber of Judgement
body: The boss arena is a square room with four golden pillars at the corners. The Arbiter awaits at the centre.

facts.label: Attempt cost
facts.note: Keys from map drops or trade

items.label: Lightning resistance 75%
items.why: All attacks deal lightning damage; chain lightning amplifies with each bounce.
items.fix: Use Topaz Flask, lightning-crafted suffixes, or Purity of Lightning.

items.label: Shock immunity
checks: Ensure shock immunity via flask or passive.
items.why: Shock increases damage taken by up to 50%; combined with chain lightning this is lethal.
items.fix: Sapphire Flask with shock immunity or Grounding passive notable.

items.label: Moderate DPS (300k+)
items.why: The fight has a soft enrage at 90 seconds where pillar frequency doubles.
items.fix: Any competent endgame build should meet this threshold.

items.label: Positioning awareness
checks: Learn the pillar safe zones before engaging.
items.why: The entire fight revolves around pillar positioning; DPS is irrelevant if you stand in chain paths.
items.fix: Watch the video guide or practise in a lower-tier trial first.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Single Chain
phases.trigger: Fight begins when you approach the centre.
objectives: Burn the Arbiter from 100% to 50% HP.
Learn the single-pillar chain timing (every 4 seconds).
notes: The Arbiter channels lightning from one pillar at a time, rotating clockwise. Each chain fires every 4 seconds and bounces 3 times.
Between chains, the Arbiter casts a holy bolt at the nearest player. Dodge laterally.
Safe zone: stand opposite the active pillar (diagonal corner).

phases.label: Phase 2 — Quad Chain
phases.trigger: Arbiter reaches 50% HP; all four pillars glow simultaneously.
objectives: Burn remaining 50% while all four pillars fire in sequence.
Rotate position clockwise to stay between active chains.
Kill the two Judgement Sentinels that spawn at 40% HP.
notes: All four pillars fire in rapid clockwise sequence with 1.5-second intervals. The safe zone rotates — you must move clockwise continuously.
At 40% HP, two Sentinels spawn and chase the player. They deal melee holy damage but have low HP. Kill them quickly or kite while focusing the Arbiter.

attacks.name: Pillar Lightning Chain
telegraph: The active pillar glows bright gold for 0.5 seconds before firing.
responses: Stay at least 5 metres from the active pillar. In Phase 2, move clockwise to stay between firing sequences.
notes: Chain bounces 3 times in Phase 1, 5 times in Phase 2. Each bounce increases damage by 20%. Maximum theoretical damage at final bounce is 2.4x base.
commonMistakes: Standing next to a pillar thinking it is safe because it is not currently active.

attacks.name: Holy Bolt
telegraph: The Arbiter points at the nearest player; a golden orb forms in 0.6 seconds.
responses: Strafe laterally. The bolt is a single-target projectile that does not chain.
notes: Moderate damage. Main danger is forcing movement into a pillar chain path.
commonMistakes: Dodging directly into the next pillar's chain zone.

attacks.name: Sentinel Slam
telegraph: Sentinel raises weapon overhead for 0.8 seconds; a 3m circle appears.
responses: Step out of the 3m radius. The slam is slow and easily avoided.
notes: Sentinels have low HP (roughly 5% of Arbiter). Kill or kite them; do not let them corner you near a pillar.
commonMistakes: Focusing Sentinels while standing in a chain path.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: The Arbiter of Divinity is primarily a positioning fight. Any build with capped lightning resistance and adequate DPS can succeed.
Movement speed is helpful but not as critical as for ground-effect bosses. The key is understanding chain timing and safe zones.
Ranged builds have an advantage because they can maintain distance from pillars while still dealing damage.
bullets: Ranged builds: stand at maximum range and rotate clockwise during Phase 2.
Melee builds: attack during the 2-second window between chain bounces; disengage before the next pillar fires.
Caster builds: use instant-cast skills while moving; avoid long channels that root you in place.
Minion builds: send minions to the Arbiter while you focus entirely on positioning.

entries.question: What is the exact safe distance from pillars?
summary: Community testing confirms 5 metres as the minimum safe distance. At 4 metres, the chain can still reach you on the first bounce. At 5+ metres, you are completely safe from that pillar's chain.
editorialAnalysis: We measured using the arena floor tiles (each tile is approximately 1 metre). Five tiles from a pillar centre is the confirmed safe threshold.

problems.symptom: I keep getting hit by chain lightning in Phase 2
checks: Confirm you are moving clockwise, not counter-clockwise.
Verify you are not stopping to attack — keep moving and use instant skills.
directAnswer: The chain fires clockwise. Move clockwise at the same speed to stay in the gap between active pillars. Stop moving only when all four pillars are in their 0.5s cooldown.

items.question: How do I reach the Arbiter of Divinity?
answer: Enter the Trial of the Sekhemas via the trial portal in the capital hub; your character must be level 60+.
The Hall of Judgment is the fourth and final hall.

items.question: What are the prerequisite trials?
answer: You must clear the Hall of Weight, Hall of Passage, and Hall of Storms before facing the Arbiter in the Hall of Judgment.

items.question: Where does the trial key come from?
answer: Trial keys drop from endgame maps or are traded; each attempt consumes one.

items.question: What does failure cost, and can I retry?
answer: Failure costs the key and all trial progress; you restart from the first hall with a new key. There is no in-trial checkpoint.

items.question: What do I unlock by defeating him?
answer: Drops Sekhemas' Judgement and other trial-exclusive uniques; completing the Hall of Judgment advances ascendancy/trial progress.
